item.title: Fecal incontinence among patients with ulcerative colitis and relation with disease activity, and extent: A cross-sectional study.
item.description: Arab journal of gastroenterology : the official publication of the Pan-Arab Association of Gastroenterology - Fecal incontinence reduces patients' quality of life. However, evidence regarding fecal incontinence in ulcerative colitis is limited. To cross-sectionally examine disease activity, disease extent,...
